answers.query: How much does VaultSpark membership cost?
answers.answer: Vault membership starts free. Vault Sparked is $4.99/mo and Vault Eternal is $29.99/mo; annual options are available for members who want one checkout for the year.

answers.query: What makes a Vault member different?
answers.answer: A free Vault Member gets the rank ladder, achievements, community challenges, and a public Vault Wall profile. Sparked and Eternal add premium access, XP boosts, profile identity, and deeper studio access. Vault Member: Free (Cross-game Vault Rank (9 tiers), Achievement tracking, Community challenges); Vault Sparked: $4.99/mo (Everything in Free, Premium access across every game, 2× XP); Vault Eternal: $29.99/mo (Everything in Sparked, Maximum everything, Purple Eternal profile theme)
